topics: Evaluate the tensile properties of a ductile material (mild steel, high-strength steel, or tor- steel) using a Universal Testing Machine (UTM) equipped with an extensometer.
Conduct compressions test on a ductile material (mild steel, tor-steel, or high-strength steel) using a Universal Testing Machine (UTM) equipped with an extensometer.
Determine the tensile properties of cast iron (a brittle material) using a Universal Testing Machine (UTM) equipped with an extensometer.
Determine the shear strength of a mild steel rod using a shear test.
Perform Brinell/Vickers/Rockwell hardness tests on a given material
Determine the torsional rigidity of mild steel/copper/brass rods.
Evaluate the flexural stiffness (flexural rigidity) of mild steel/copper/brass specimens using a three-point bend test on a Universal Testing Machine (UTM)
Determine the notch toughness of the material at room temperature using Izod and Charpy impact testing.
Investigate the effect of coil type (close-coiled vs. open-coiled) and arrangement (series vs. parallel) on spring stiffness.
Microstructure of mild steel/copper/ brass/aluminium using opticalmicroscope, double disc polishing machine, emery papers and etchant.
Analyse the fracture surface morphology of a ductile or brittle material using an optical microscope for fractographic characterisation.
Evaluate the fracture toughness of a material with a Universal Testing Machine (UTM)
To study the procedure for plotting S-N curve using Fatigue testing machine
Measure the deformation (strain) of an object using strain gauges.
Perform a bending test on a wooden beam to assess its load-carrying capacity.
